compute_legendre_polynomials: compute Legendre polynomials up to a given lmax for a tensor of x values using standard recursion
calculate_bond_orientational_order: calculate Bond-Orientational Order for graph nodes from direction vectors and neighbor masks using spherical harmonics
map_node_features_to_edges: map sender and receiver node features to edge features using a neighbor list for graph message passing
build_compact_frequency_vectors: build compact frequency vectors from edge direction tensors using spherical harmonics with configurable repeating dimensions
create_attention_mask_for_graph: create an attention mask and angle embeddings for graph attention from edge directions and neighbor masks
